set -eu
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/menu-recovery-4decbe6-20261125"
if test -f "$stage/terms-public-check.html";then
 python3 - "$stage/terms-public-check.html" <<'PY'
import sys,html,re,hashlib,unicodedata
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class Text(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.parts=[]
 def handle_data(self,s): self.parts.append(s)
raw=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
p=Text(); p.feed(raw.decode('utf-8','replace'))
s=unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',' '.join(p.parts))
print('TERMS_HTTP_BODY_BYTES='+str(len(raw)))
print('TERMS_HTTP_BODY_SHA256='+hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
for marker in ['CreateVdobot','利用規約','販売約款','規約バージョン','1.0','Telegram Stars','第1条','第2条','第3条']:
 print('TERM_MARKER '+marker+'='+str(marker.casefold() in s.casefold()))
print('TERMS_TITLE='+re.sub(r'<[^>]*>','',re.search(r'<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>',raw.decode('utf-8','replace'),re.I|re.S).group(1))[:150] if re.search(r'<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>',raw.decode('utf-8','replace'),re.I|re.S) else 'NO_HTML_TITLE')
PY
else echo TERMS_HTTP_BODY_NOT_AVAILABLE;fi
